135.name: Admiralty Islands lowland rain forests

785.name: Aegean and Western Turkey sclerophyllous and mixed forests
785.lead: The Aegean and Western Turkey sclerophyllous and mixed forests is an ecoregion in the lands around the Aegean Sea.
785.wiki: Aegean and Western Turkey sclerophyllous and mixed forests

807.name: Afghan Mountains semi-desert
807.lead: The Afghan Mountains semi-desert ecoregion (WWF ID: PA1301) covers three disconnected interior valleys in the north of the mountains of Afghanistan.

722.name: Al-Hajar foothill xeric woodlands and shrublands

723.name: Al-Hajar montane woodlands and shrublands
723.lead: Al Hajar montane woodlands is a temperate grasslands, savannas and shrublands ecoregion in the Hajar Mountains of the eastern part of the Arabian Peninsula, which extends across portions of Oman and the U.A.E.

721.name: Alai-Western Tian Shan steppe
721.lead: The Alai-Western Tian Shan steppe ecoregion (WWF ID: PA0801) covers the foothills on the western edge of the Tien Shan and Alay Mountains of Central Asia.

808.name: Alashan Plateau semi-desert
808.lead: The Alashan Plateau semi-desert ecoregion (WWF ID: PA1302) covers the southwestern portion of the Gobi Desert where precipitation in the mountains is sufficient for a short part of the summer to support sparse plant life.

405.name: Alaska-St. Elias Range tundra
405.lead: Elias Range tundra is an ecoregion of northwestern North America.

photo.by: Jack French from San Francisco, USA

369.name: Alaska Peninsula montane taiga
369.lead: The Alaska Peninsula montane taiga is a taiga and boreal forests ecoregion, located in Alaska, and defined by the World Wildlife Fund (WWF) categorization system.

88.name: Albany thickets
88.lead: The Albany thickets is an ecoregion of dense woodland in southern South Africa, which is concentrated around the Albany region of the Eastern Cape (whence the region's name originates).

345.name: Alberta-British Columbia foothills forests
345.lead: The Alberta–British Columbia foothills forests are a temperate coniferous forests ecoregion of Western Canada, as defined by the World Wildlife Fund (WWF) categorization system.

1.name: Albertine Rift montane forests
1.lead: The Albertine Rift montane forests (French: Forêts montagnardes du Rift Albertin) is a tropical moist broadleaf forest ecoregion in east-central Africa.

91.name: Aldabra Island xeric scrub
91.lead: Aldabra, the world's second-largest coral atoll (the largest is Kiritimati), is located east of the continent of Africa.

photo.by: NASA Earth Observatory image by Wanmei Liang, using Landsat

406.name: Aleutian Islands tundra
406.lead: The Aleutian Islands (; , "land of the Aleuts"; possibly from the Chukchi , or "island")—also called the Aleut Islands, Aleutic Islands, or, before the Alaska Purchase in 1867, the Catherine Archipelago—are a chain of 14 main, larger volcanic islands and 55 smaller ones.

328.name: Allegheny Highlands forests
328.lead: The Allegheny Highlands forests are a temperate broadleaf and mixed forests ecoregion located in a large part of the Allegheny Plateau physiographic province, including both unglaciated and glaciated portions, in Pennsylvania and New York within North America, as defined by the World Wildlife Fund.

photo.by: The original uploader was Daniel Case at English Wikipedia.

689.name: Alps conifer and mixed forests
689.lead: The Alps conifer and mixed forests is a temperate coniferous forest ecoregion in central Europe.

749.name: Altai alpine meadow and tundra
749.lead: The Altai alpine meadow and tundra ecoregion (WWF ID: PA1001) is a terrestrial ecoregion covering the higher elevation of the Altai Mountains at the center of the "X" formed by the borders separating Russia, Kazakhstan, China, and Mongolia.

690.name: Altai montane forest and forest steppe
690.lead: The Altai montane forest and forest steppe ecoregion (WWF ID: PA0502) covers patches of the subalpine forest belt on the Altai Mountains, crossing the border region where Russia, Kazakhstan, Mongolia and China meet.
690.wiki: Altai montane forest and forest steppe

724.name: Altai steppe and semi-desert
724.lead: The Altai steppe and semi-desert ecoregion (WWF ID: PA0802), as its name indicates, sits in a transition zone between steppe and semi-desert, supporting sparse grass and shrublands.

439.name: Alto Paraná Atlantic forests
439.lead: The Alto Paraná Atlantic forests, also known as the Paraná-Paraíba interior forests, is an ecoregion of the tropical moist forests biome, and the South American Atlantic Forest biome.

611.name: Amazon-Orinoco-Southern Caribbean mangroves
611.lead: The Amazon–Orinoco–Southern Caribbean mangroves (NT1401) is an ecoregion along the coasts of Colombia, Venezuela, Guyana, Suriname, French Guiana and Brazil.

741.name: Amur meadow steppe
741.lead: The Amur meadow steppe ecoregion (WWF ID: PA0901) is spread over two sections of the middle Amur River valley in the Russian Far East.

786.name: Anatolian conifer and deciduous mixed forests
786.lead: The Anatolian conifer and deciduous mixed forests is an ecoregion located in southwestern Anatolia, Turkey.
786.wiki: Anatolian conifer and deciduous mixed forests

218.name: Andaman Islands rain forests
218.lead: Together with the Nicobar Islands to their south, the Andamans serve as a maritime boundary between the Bay of Bengal to the west and the Andaman Sea to the east.

34.name: Angolan mopane woodlands
34.lead: This ecosystem surrounds Etosha Pan, which is considered a separate ecoregion.

35.name: Angolan scarp savanna and woodlands
35.lead: The Angolan Scarp savanna and woodlands is an ecoregion located on the coast of Angola, an area with a variety of habitats and rich in wildlife including many endemic birds and animals.

36.name: Angolan wet miombo woodlands
36.lead: Angolan miombo woodlands cover most of central Angola and extend into the Democratic Republic of Congo.

196.name: Antipodes Subantarctic Islands tundra
196.lead: The Antipodes Subantarctic Islands tundra ecoregion, within the tundra biome, includes five remote island groups in the Pacific Ocean south of New Zealand: the Bounty Islands, Auckland Islands, Antipodes Islands and Campbell Island groups of New Zealand, and Macquarie Island of Australia.

331.name: Appalachian-Blue Ridge forests
331.lead: The Appalachian–Blue Ridge forests are an ecoregion in the Temperate broadleaf and mixed forests Biome, in the Eastern United States.

329.name: Appalachian mixed mesophytic forests
329.lead: The Appalachian mixed mesophytic forests is an ecoregion of the temperate broadleaf and mixed forests biome, as defined by the World Wildlife Fund.

644.name: Appenine deciduous montane forests
644.lead: The Apennine deciduous montane forests are a temperate broadleaf and mixed forests ecoregion in the Apennine Mountains of Italy.

520.name: Apure-Villavicencio dry forests
520.lead: The Apure–Villavicencio dry forests (NT0201) is an ecoregion in Venezuela and Colombia to the east of the eastern cordillera of the Andes.

440.name: Araucaria moist forests
440.lead: The Araucaria moist forests, officially classified as mixed ombrophilous forest (Portuguese: "Floresta Ombrófila Mista") in Brazil, are a montane subtropical moist forest ecoregion.

597.name: Araya and Paria xeric scrub
597.lead: The Araya and Paria xeric scrub (NT1301) is an ecoregion in Venezuela that stretches along the Caribbean coast to the west of Trinidad, and that includes Margarita Island and some smaller islands.

407.name: Arctic coastal tundra
407.lead: The Arctic coastal tundra is an ecoregion of the far north of North America, an important breeding ground for a great deal of wildlife.

408.name: Arctic foothills tundra
408.lead: The Arctic foothills tundra is an ecoregion of the far north of North America, lying inland from the north coast of Alaska.

346.name: Arizona Mountains forests
346.lead: The Arizona/New Mexico Mountains ecoregion is a Level III ecoregion designated by the United States Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) in the U.S.

181.name: Arnhem Land tropical savanna
181.lead: The Arnhem Land tropical savanna is a tropical and subtropical grasslands, savannas, and shrublands ecoregion in Australia's Northern Territory.

37.name: Ascension scrub and grasslands
37.lead: The Ascension scrub and grasslands ecoregion covers the dormant volcano, Ascension Island in the Atlantic Ocean.

598.name: Atacama desert
598.lead: The Atacama Desert  is a desert plateau on the Pacific coast of South America, stretching along a 1600 km strip of land in northern Chile, west of the Andes.

441.name: Atlantic Coast restingas
441.lead: The Atlantic Coast restingas is an ecoregion of the tropical and subtropical moist broadleaf forests biome, and the South American Atlantic Forest biome.

347.name: Atlantic coastal pine barrens
347.lead: The Atlantic coastal pine barrens, now a rare temperate coniferous forest ecoregion of the Northeast United States, is distinguished by unique species and topographical features (coastal plain ponds, frost pocket), generally nutrient-poor, often acidic soils, and a pine tree distribution once controlled by frequent fires.

5.name: Congolian coastal forests
5.lead: The Atlantic Equatorial coastal forests, also known as the Congolian coastal forests (French: Forêts côtières équatoriales atlantiques, Spanish: Bosques costeros atlánticos ecuatoriales, Portuguese: Florestas costeiras atlânticas equatoriais), are a tropical moist broadleaf forest ecoregion of Central Africa, covering hills, plains, and mountains of the Atlantic coast of Cameroon, Equatorial Guinea, Gabon, Republic of the Congo, Angola, and Democratic Republic the of Congo.

664.name: European Atlantic mixed forests
664.lead: The Atlantic mixed forests is a terrestrial ecoregion in western Europe.

193.name: Australian Alps montane grasslands
193.lead: The Australian Alps montane grasslands is a montane grassland ecoregion of south-eastern Australia, restricted to the montane regions above 1300 metres (the upper altitudinal limit of Eucalyptus pauciflora).

812.name: Azerbaijan shrub desert and steppe
812.lead: The Azerbaijan shrub desert and steppe is a deserts and xeric shrublands ecoregion in western Asia.

645.name: Azores temperate mixed forests
645.lead: The Azores temperate mixed forests is a temperate broadleaf and mixed forests ecoregion of southwestern Europe.

813.name: Badghyz and Karabil semi-desert
813.lead: The Badghyz and Karabil semi-desert ecoregion (WWF ID: PA1306) covers the hills north of the central mountain ranges of Afghanistan, southeast Turkmenistan, and portions of Uzbekistan and Tajikistan.

612.name: Bahamian-Antillean mangroves
612.lead: The Greater Antilles mangroves is a mangrove ecoregion that includes the coastal mangrove forests of the Greater Antilles – Cuba, Hispaniola, Jamaica, and Puerto Rico.

442.name: Bahia coastal forests
442.lead: The Bahia coastal forests are a tropical moist broadleaf forest ecoregion of eastern Brazil, part of the larger Atlantic Forest region.

443.name: Bahia interior forests
443.lead: The Bahia interior forests is an ecoregion of eastern Brazil.

426.name: Baja California desert
426.lead: The Baja California desert  is a desert ecoregion of Mexico's Baja California peninsula.

521.name: Bajío dry forests
521.lead: The Bajío dry forests is a tropical dry broadleaf forest ecoregion in western−central Mexico.

646.name: Balkan mixed forests
646.lead: The Balkan mixed forests are a terrestrial ecoregion of southeastern Europe according to both the WWF and Digital Map of European Ecological Regions by the European Environment Agency.

photo.by: Ministry of Environment and Water of Bulgaria

522.name: Balsas dry forests
522.lead: The Balsas dry forests is a tropical dry broadleaf forest ecoregion located in western and central Mexico.

647.name: Baltic mixed forests
647.lead: The Baltic mixed forests is an ecoregion in Europe along the southwestern coasts of the Baltic Sea.

814.name: Baluchistan xeric woodlands
814.lead: The Balochistan xeric woodlands ecoregion (WWF ID: PA1307) covers the middle elevations of a series of mountain ranges of western Pakistan and northeastern Afghanistan, reaching 1200 km from the Arabian Sea in the south to the Hindu Kush Mountains and the Himalayas in the north.

136.name: Banda Sea Islands moist deciduous forests
136.lead: The Banda Sea Islands moist deciduous forests is a tropical moist forest ecoregion in Indonesia.
136.wiki: Banda Sea Islands moist deciduous forests

564.name: Belizian pine savannas
564.lead: The Belizean pine forests is an ecoregion that represents an example of lowland and premontane pine forests in the Neotropical realm, where the dominant tree species is Caribbean pine.

565.name: Beni savanna
565.lead: The Llanos de Moxos, also known as the Beni savanna or Moxos plains, is a tropical savanna ecoregion of the Beni Department of northern Bolivia.

409.name: Beringia lowland tundra
409.lead: The Beringia lowland tundra is a tundra ecoregion of North America, on the west coast of Alaska, mostly covered in wetland.

photo.by: Cline, David - U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service

410.name: Beringia upland tundra
410.lead: The Beringia upland tundra is a mountainous tundra ecoregion of North America, on the west coast of Alaska.

325.name: Bermuda subtropical conifer forests
325.lead: Bermuda's ecology has an abundance of unique flora and fauna due to the island's isolation from the mainland of North America.

photo.by: Seán Pòl Ó Creachmhaoil Aodhdubh at English Wikipedia

137.name: Biak-Numfoor rain forests
137.lead: The Biak–Numfoor rain forests is a tropical moist forest ecoregion in Indonesia.

348.name: Blue Mountains forests
348.lead: The Blue Mountains ecoregion is a Level III ecoregion designated by the United States Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) in the Pacific Northwest, mainly in the state of Oregon, with small areas over the state border in Idaho and southeastern Washington.

photo.by: Miguel Vieira from Walnut Creek, CA, USA (en user page)

742.name: Bohai Sea saline meadow
742.lead: The Bohai Sea saline meadow ecoregion (WWF ID: PA0902) covers the coastal deltas of the Yellow River and the Luan River where they enter the Bohai Sea in China.

523.name: Bolivian montane dry forests
523.lead: The Bolivian montane dry forests (NT0206) is an ecoregion in Bolivia on the eastern side of the Andes.

444.name: Bolivian Yungas
444.lead: The Bolivian Yungas is a tropical and subtropical moist broadleaf forest ecoregion in the Yungas of central Bolivia.

219.name: Borneo lowland rain forests
219.lead: The Borneo lowland rain forests is an ecoregion, within the tropical and subtropical moist broadleaf forests biome, of the large island of Borneo in Southeast Asia.

221.name: Borneo peat swamp forests
221.lead: The Borneo peat swamp forests ecoregion, within the tropical and subtropical moist broadleaf forests biome, are on the island of Borneo, which is divided between Brunei, Indonesia and Malaysia.

222.name: Brahmaputra Valley semi-evergreen forests
222.lead: The Brahmaputra Valley semi-evergreen forests is a tropical moist broadleaf forest ecoregion of Northeastern India, southern Bhutan and adjacent Bangladesh.

182.name: Brigalow tropical savanna
182.lead: The Brigalow Belt is a wide band of acacia-wooded grassland that runs between tropical rainforest of the coast and the semi-arid interior of Queensland and northern New South Wales, Australia.

411.name: Brooks-British Range tundra
411.lead: The Brooks–British Range tundra is an ecoregion spanning North America and Canada, and is one of the WWF Global 200 ecoregions.

138.name: Buru rain forests
138.lead: Buru (formerly spelled Boeroe, Boro, or Bouru) is the third largest island within the Maluku Islands of Indonesia.

525.name: Caatinga
525.lead: Caatinga  is a type of semi-arid tropical vegetation, and an ecoregion characterized by this vegetation in interior northeastern Brazil.

445.name: Caatinga Enclaves moist forests
445.lead: The Caatinga enclaves moist forests is an ecoregion of the Tropical moist forests Biome, and the South American Atlantic Forest biome.

691.name: Caledon conifer forests
691.lead: The Caledonian Forest is the ancient (old-growth) temperate forest of Scotland.

385.name: California Central Valley grasslands
385.lead: The California Central Valley grasslands is a temperate grasslands, savannas, and shrublands ecoregion in California's Central Valley.

photo.by: California Department of Fish and Wildlife from Sacramento,

422.name: California coastal sage and chaparral
422.lead: The California coastal sage and chaparral is a Mediterranean forests, woodlands, and scrub ecoregion, defined by the World Wildlife Fund, located in southwestern California (United States) and northwestern Baja California (Mexico).

photo.by: Jeff Turner from Santa Clarita, CA, United States

423.name: California interior chaparral and woodlands
423.lead: The California interior chaparral and woodlands ecoregion covers 24900 mi2 in an elliptical ring around the California Central Valley.

424.name: California montane chaparral and woodlands
424.lead: The California montane chaparral and woodlands is an ecoregion defined by the World Wildlife Fund, spanning 7900 mi2 of mountains in the Transverse Ranges, Peninsular Ranges, and Coast Ranges of southern and central California.

2.name: Cameroon Highlands forests
2.lead: The Cameroonian Highlands forests, also known as the Cameroon Highlands forests, is a montane tropical moist broadleaf forest ecoregion located on the range of mountains that runs inland from the Gulf of Guinea and forms the border between Cameroon and Nigeria.

566.name: Campos Rupestres montane savanna
566.lead: The campo rupestre ("rupestrian grassland") is a discontinuous montane subtropical ecoregion occurring across three different biomes in Brazil: Cerrado, Atlantic Forest and Caatinga.

386.name: Canadian Aspen forests and parklands
386.lead: Aspen parkland refers to a very large area of transitional biome between prairie and boreal forest in two sections, namely the Peace River Country of northwestern Alberta crossing the border into British Columbia, and a much larger area stretching from central Alberta, all across central Saskatchewan to south central Manitoba and continuing into small parts of the US states of Minnesota and North Dakota.

787.name: Canary Islands dry woodlands and forests
787.lead: The Canary Islands dry woodlands and forests is a Mediterranean forests, woodlands, and scrub ecoregion in the Canary Islands.
787.wiki: Canary Islands dry woodlands and forests

648.name: Cantabrian mixed forests
648.lead: The Cantabrian mixed forests is a temperate broadleaf and mixed forests ecoregion in southwestern Europe.

190.name: Canterbury-Otago tussock grasslands
190.lead: The Canterbury–Otago tussock grasslands is an ecoregion of the South Island, New Zealand, part of the wider tussock grasslands of New Zealand.

31.name: Cape Verde Islands dry forests
31.lead: The Cape Verde Islands dry forests is a tropical and subtropical dry broadleaf forests ecoregion in the Cape Verde Islands, which constitute the country of Cabo Verde.

183.name: Cape York Peninsula tropical savanna
183.lead: The Cape York Peninsula tropical savanna is a tropical grasslands, savannas, and shrublands ecoregion in northern Australia.

446.name: Caqueta moist forests
446.lead: The Caquetá moist forests (NT0107) is an ecoregion of tropical moist broad leaf forest to the east of the Andes in the east of Colombia, with a small section in Brazil, in the Amazon biome.

223.name: Cardamom Mountains rain forests
223.lead: The Cardamom Mountains rain forests is a tropical moist broadleaf forest ecoregion in Southeast Asia, as identified by the WWF.

207.name: Carnarvon xeric shrublands
207.lead: The Carnarvon xeric shrublands is a deserts and xeric shrublands ecoregion of Western Australia.

618.name: Carolines tropical moist forests
618.lead: The Carolines tropical moist forests is a tropical and subtropical moist broadleaf forests ecoregion in Micronesia.

photo.by: Geoffrey Rhodes from Helensvale - Gold Coast, Australia

692.name: Carpathian montane forests
692.lead: The Carpathian montane conifer forests, also known as Carpathian montane forests, is a temperate coniferous forests ecoregion in the Carpathian Mountains of the Czech Republic, Poland, Slovakia, Romania, and Ukraine.

184.name: Carpentaria tropical savanna
184.lead: The Carpentaria tropical savanna is a tropical and subtropical grasslands, savannas, and shrublands ecoregion in northern Australia.

649.name: Caspian Hyrcanian mixed forests
649.lead: The Hyrcanian forests  are a zone of lush lowland and montane forests covering about 55000 km2 near the shores of the Caspian Sea in Iran and Azerbaijan.

815.name: Caspian lowland desert
815.lead: The Caspian lowland desert ecoregion (WWF ID: PA1308) covers the north and southeast coasts of the Caspian Sea, including the deltas of the Volga River and Ural River in the northern region.

447.name: Catatumbo moist forests
447.lead: The Catatumbo moist forests (NT0108) is an ecoregion in Venezuela and Colombia to the west and east of Lake Maracaibo.

526.name: Cauca Valley dry forests
526.lead: The Cauca Valley dry forests is a tropical dry broadleaf forest ecoregion in Colombia.

448.name: Cauca Valley montane forests
448.lead: The Cauca Valley montane forests (NT0109) is an ecoregion in western Colombia.

650.name: Caucasus mixed forests
650.lead: The Caucasus mixed forests is a temperate broadleaf and mixed forests ecoregion in the Caucasus Mountains, as well as the adjacent Lesser Caucasus range and the eastern end of the Pontic Mountains.

449.name: Cayos Miskitos-San Andrés and Providencia moist forests
449.lead: The Cayos Miskitos-San Andrés & Providencia moist forests ecoregion (WWF ID:NT0110) cover the forested areas of four islands in the western Caribbean Sea - Cayos Miskitos and the Corn Islands off the east coast of Nicaragua, and San Andrés and Providencia Islands farther east and belonging to the nation of Colombia.
449.wiki: Cayos Miskitos–San Andrés and Providencia moist forests

651.name: Celtic broadleaf forests
651.lead: The Celtic broadleaf forests are a terrestrial ecoregion that covers most of the islands of Great Britain and Ireland.

816.name: Central Afghan Mountains xeric woodlands
816.lead: The Central Afghan Mountains xeric woodlands ecoregion (WWF ID: PA1309) covers the xeric (dry) eastern and southern slopes of the central mountain range of Afghanistan, between the sandy desert to the south and the alpine meadows in the higher, wetter region to the north.

111.name: Central African mangroves
111.lead: The Central African mangroves ecoregion consists of the largest area of mangrove swamp in Africa, located on the coasts of West Africa, mainly in Nigeria.

450.name: Central American Atlantic moist forests
450.lead: The Central American Atlantic moist forests ecoregion (WWF ID: NT0111) covers the lowland coastal forests of Honduras, southeast Guatemala, and the eastern forests of Nicaragua (plus two small patches in Belize).

527.name: Central American dry forests
527.lead: The Central American dry forests ecoregion, of the tropical and subtropical dry broadleaf forests biome, is located in Central America.

451.name: Central American montane forests
451.lead: The Central American montane forests are an ecoregion of the tropical and subtropical moist broadleaf forests biome, as defined by the World Wildlife Fund, located in mountains of Central America.

553.name: Central American pine-oak forests
553.lead: The Central American pine–oak forests is a tropical and subtropical coniferous forests ecoregion in the mountains of northern Central America and Chiapas state in southern Mexico.

725.name: Central Anatolian steppe
725.lead: The Central Anatolian steppe is a Palearctic ecoregion in the temperate grasslands, savannas, and shrublands biome.

652.name: Central Anatolian steppe and woodlands
652.lead: The Central Anatolian deciduous forests, also known as the Central Anatolian woodlands and steppe, is a Palearctic ecoregion of the Temperate broadleaf and mixed forest biome.

587.name: Central Andean dry puna
587.lead: The Central Andean dry puna (NT1001) is an ecoregion in the montane grasslands and shrublands biome, located in the Andean Altiplano (high plateau) in South America.

588.name: Central Andean puna
588.lead: The Central Andean puna is a montane grasslands and shrublands ecoregion in the Andes of southern Peru, Bolivia, and northern Chile and Argentina.

589.name: Central Andean wet puna
589.lead: The Central Andean wet puna is a montane grasslands and shrublands ecoregion in the Andes of Peru and Bolivia.

817.name: Central Asian northern desert
817.lead: The Central Asian northern desert is an ecoregion in the deserts and xeric shrublands biome, located in the Central Asian countries of Kazakhstan and Uzbekistan.

818.name: Central Asian riparian woodlands
818.lead: The Central Asian riparian woodlands ecoregion (WWF ID: PA1311) is spread out across the deserts and plains of central Asia between the Aral Sea and the mountains 2000 km to the east.

819.name: Central Asian southern desert
819.lead: The Central Asian southern desert ecoregion (WWF ID: PA1312) is an arid but ecologically active region between the east coast of the Caspian Sea and steppes at the base of the mountains of central Asia.

350.name: Central British Columbia Mountain forests
350.lead: The Central British Columbia Mountain forests is a temperate coniferous forest ecoregion in north-central British Columbia, as defined by the World Wildlife Fund (WWF) categorization system.

370.name: Central Canadian Shield forests
370.lead: The Central Canadian Shield forests are a taiga ecoregion of Eastern Canada, as defined by the World Wildlife Fund (WWF) categorization system.

653.name: Central China Loess Plateau mixed forests

3.name: Central Congolian lowland forests
3.lead: The Central Congolian lowland forests (French: Forêts de plaine du centre du Congo) are an ecoregion within the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

290.name: Central Deccan Plateau dry deciduous forests

290.wiki: Central Deccan Plateau dry deciduous forests

654.name: Central European mixed forests
654.lead: The Central European mixed forests ecoregion (WWF ID: PA0412) is a temperate hardwood forest covering much of northeastern Europe, from Germany to Russia.

291.name: Central Indochina dry forests
291.lead: The Central Indochina dry forests are a large tropical and subtropical dry broadleaf forests ecoregion in Southeast Asia.

655.name: Central Korean deciduous forests
655.lead: The Central Korean deciduous forests is a temperate broadleaf and mixed forests ecoregion on the Korean Peninsula, covering portions of South Korea and North Korea.

427.name: Central Mexican matorral
427.lead: The Central Mexican matorral is an ecoregion of the deserts and xeric shrublands biome of central Mexico: the southernmost ecoregion of the Nearctic realm.

820.name: Central Persian desert basins
820.lead: The Central Persian desert basins ecoregion (WWF ID: PA1313) covers the arid steppe and desert basins of central Iran, stretching into northwestern Afghanistan.

619.name: Central Polynesian tropical moist forests
619.lead: The Central Polynesian tropical moist forests is a tropical and subtropical moist broadleaf forests ecoregion in Polynesia.

139.name: Central Range Papuan montane rain forests

750.name: Central Tibetan Plateau alpine steppe
750.lead: The Central Tibetan Plateau alpine steppe ecoregion (WWF ID: PA1002) covers the high alpine plateau that stretches over 1600 km across the Tibetan Plateau to Qinghai Lake in China.

39.name: Central Zambezian wet miombo woodlands
39.lead: The Central Zambezian miombo woodlands ecoregion spans southern central Africa.

photo.by: Geoff Gallice from Gainesville, FL, USA

567.name: Cerrado
567.lead: The Cerrado  is a vast ecoregion of tropical savanna in central Brazil, being present in the states of Goiás, Mato Grosso do Sul, Mato Grosso, Tocantins, Maranhão, Piauí, Bahia, Minas Gerais, São Paulo, Paraná and the Federal District.

656.name: Changbai Mountains mixed forests
656.lead: The Changbai Mountains mixed forests ecoregion (WWF ID: PA0414) covers the Changbai Mountains and surrounding foothills in China and North Korea.

657.name: Changjiang Plain evergreen forests
657.lead: The Changjiang Plain evergreen forests ecoregion (WWF ID: PA0415) covers the plain of the Yangtze River (Changjiang) from where it leaves the mountains at the Three Gorges in the west, to the mouth of the Yangtze at the East China Sea.

224.name: Chao Phraya freshwater swamp forests
224.lead: The Chao Phraya freshwater swamp forests is a tropical and subtropical moist broadleaf forests ecoregion in Thailand.

225.name: Chao Phraya lowland moist deciduous forests
225.lead: The Chao Phraya lowland moist deciduous forests is a tropical moist broadleaf forest ecoregion in Thailand.
225.wiki: Chao Phraya lowland moist deciduous forests

167.name: Chatham Island temperate forests
